questions.title: GATE EE — EM Fields | Faraday's Law & Maxwell's Equations
questions.subject: Electromagnetic Fields
questions.question: Maxwell's divergence equation $\nabla \cdot \vec{B} = 0$ physically asserts that:
options: Isolated magnetic monopoles do not exist in nature
Electric field is conservative in static conditions
Magnetic flux changes induce an electromotive force
Total charge inside a closed volume is conserved

structuredOptions.label: A
structuredOptions.text: Isolated magnetic monopoles do not exist in nature
structuredOptions.html: Isolated magnetic monopoles do not exist in nature

structuredOptions.label: B
structuredOptions.text: Electric field is conservative in static conditions
structuredOptions.html: Electric field is conservative in static conditions

structuredOptions.label: C
structuredOptions.text: Magnetic flux changes induce an electromotive force
structuredOptions.html: Magnetic flux changes induce an electromotive force

structuredOptions.label: D
structuredOptions.text: Total charge inside a closed volume is conserved
structuredOptions.html: Total charge inside a closed volume is conserved

questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Electromagnetic Fields):

$\nabla \cdot \vec{B} = 0$ states that magnetic flux lines are always continuous closed loops, proving that isolated single magnetic poles (monopoles) do not exist.
